problems.rationale: The route that can finish is a logged scutoid-frequency comparison on the Gómez-Gálvez 2018 bins or a few open segmented volumes; a clear miss is a falsifier of the energy account, and a Lean area bound is the only mathematical acceptance example with a chance. The blocker is that the supplement may be figures rather than numeric bins, three tissue types plus a foam model are a heavy pipeline, and a certified Weaire–Phelan local minimum needs spectral enclosures the proposer marks as research-level. A year adds a second dataset and a conditional lower bound. Annealing records and narrow formal comparisons answer smaller questions than the joint acceptance criteria.

approaches.note: Rigorous eigenvalue enclosure on curved Plateau borders is beyond a month of agent time, and an unfinished enclosure is not a local-minimum certificate.
A lower bound that takes the 3D isoperimetric inequality as a named hypothesis is a realistic Lean target, while an unconditional Mathlib proof of that inequality is not.
Open epithelial volumes exist, but segmentation error on apical and basal surfaces can leave the three-tissue comparison measurement-limited.
Thirty volumes of 200 cells with topology F1 above 0.95 asks for more diverse open epithelia than the slice shows are in hand.
A finite-dimensional Hessian certificate still lacks an exact curved-face representation and a bridge to arbitrary variations.
Reading one supplement and applying a frozen tolerance is agent-scale, and a stop because the tables are images is inconclusive.
Four hundred Surface Evolver anneals can be logged, and a negative search leaves Kelvin's problem open unless a foam beats Weaire–Phelan.
Separating the Kelvin and Weaire–Phelan areas in Lean needs a numeric certificate of the curved cells, which is harder than the shared-face inequality.

problems.rationale: ZFIN morpholino and mutant files plus Ensembl paralogues are public, INDRA is in the swarm, and either a held-out AUROC above the pre-registered bar or a definitive collapse to the base rate meets the acceptance criteria or the falsifier. The blocker is phenotype matching: system, stage and allele class may leave fewer than about 150 comparable genes, which is inconclusive rather than a refutation. A year of label revision and family-held-out models raises the chance a clean table exists. The ranked list does not need a wet-lab follow-up to count.

approaches.note: A frozen logistic or tree model on ZFIN labels is executable, and the result is decisive only if the matched-gene count clears the stated floor.
The two-feature odds ratio is a single pre-registered test, and missing PTC or promoter-less allele annotations can empty the within-gene contrast.
Off-target alignment of every morpholino is heavier than the gene-feature models, and paralogue count may be confounded with off-target load.
Kappa 0.8 double labeling and a temporal holdout demand manual curation the proposer already flags as missing.
Mediation needs public mutant RNA-seq paired to matched morphant and mutant phenotypes, which the approach lists as absent.
The Boolean NMD-plus-paralog rule on named ZFIN files can be scored on a family holdout, and a precision interval covering the base rate is a real refutation.
Once labels exist, an L2 logistic with an INDRA ablation has a sharp AUROC gate that either clears 0.70 or lands on the falsifier.
Publishing a top-50 list is in scope, and a non-monotone reliability diagram fails the list even when the likelihood-ratio test passes.

problems.rationale: The acceptance test is mean-intercept fabric versus a pre-registered finite-element load on at least three open micro-CT volumes from two species, and a median angle stuck on the 60-degree random-axis null is a falsifier. The blocker is licence and load metadata: excised cubes and scans without a defensible physiological direction get dropped, so the sample gate is the risk. The shear-lemma completion chance times its settlement chance is about 0.53, and the remodelling simulations sit near 0.37; those artifacts do not measure real bone, which is why p_solved_30d stays with the scan test. A year of MorphoSource scouting and coarser load cases can still reach three usable sites, without a new animal reorientation experiment.

approaches.note: BoneJ fabric plus a homogenized hip load is feasible when three licensed whole bones survive, and a flat load sweep is a load-case falsifier.
A voxel remodelling loop can separate load weight 1 from weight 0 on synthetic domains, and that table calibrates the null rather than scoring real femora.
Extending the existing principal-direction lemma to the two shear rules is a closed real-analysis proof, and it leaves whether bone follows either rule untested.
Extractable reorientation angles with dispersion may fall below five experiments, which stalls the causal meta-regression.
Blind load cases on femoral head, vertebra and calcaneus from two species depend on paired geometry and load metadata the proposer says must be scouted first.
Ranking held-out loads on at least 20 specimens needs a public loading-class set that is not established in the slice.
Named Leeds, Palanca, DaRUS and Doube volumes make the download concrete, and many Doube stacks are excised cubes that the gates drop.
A 2D Huiskes update with a frozen lazy zone can show reorientation after a 30-degree load turn, as a sufficiency result on a silhouette.
Shear vanishing exactly on 2D principal directions, given the existing orthogonality lemma, is a short no-sorry target.

problems.rationale: Acceptance is a leave-one-family-out meta-analysis of at least 40 toughness records across five families, and a constituent-only model that matches within the error bound is a falsifier. The blocker is commensurability: K_Ic and work of fracture differ, interface thickness is often missing, and several source papers are paywalled, so the coverage bar may fail without refuting the claim. The Voigt-bound formalization has completion times settlement near 0.49, and the self-similar sweep near 0.39; both answer a model, which is why p_solved_30d stays near the extraction chance. A year of dual extraction can still assemble a protocol-stratified table.

approaches.note: Forty provenanced records are extractable in principle, and hydration and specimen size can explain more variance than the level count.
A 2D lattice-spring fracture sweep at fixed mineral fraction can show whether work of fracture rises with level count inside that model.
The tension-shear chain bound by the Voigt modulus is an algebraic Lean induction, and it constrains stiffness rather than measured toughness.
Requiring commensurable protocols before pooling will drop many of the 40 rows the coverage bar demands.
A matched cohesive-zone factorial can isolate a hierarchy interaction after holding interface area fixed, inside the 2D model.
Dropping every row that lacks interface compliance or a single toughness definition makes the 40-record, five-family bar the likely failure.
Sweeping a transcribed Zhang–Gao recurrence is ordinary Python, and a mismatch with the paper voids the monotone-or-not answer.
Exhibiting a rational point where the transcribed toughness falls between levels is a real Lean obligation that dies if the transcription is wrong.

problems.rationale: Acceptance needs at least 100 structures of four types, each with a matched tissue modulus, classified against the stiffness-per-mass optimum and the buckling limit. The blocker is the modulus match: mammal tables supply hollowness, feather and stem compilations are thin, and a same-paper modulus is rare, so the sample gate fails more often than the biology is refuted. The gas-core Lean lemma has completion times settlement near 0.40 and does not measure those structures, which is why p_solved_30d stays low. A year of table hunting can reach a four-type classification or a clear buckling cluster on the rows that do have moduli.

approaches.note: Empty-tube monotonicity and a unique marrow-adjusted K-star are calculus lemmas in Lean, and they define the predictions the data test still has to run.
One hundred modulus-matched structures across bones, culms and rachises is the acceptance bar, and feather and stem moduli are the sparse part.
Shaft-wise K from MorphoSource CT tests one bone claim, and many specimens need download permission the swarm cannot sign.
Proving that unconstrained bending stiffness rises as material moves outward, with the optimum on an active constraint, is a compact Lean argument.
Uncertainty-aware distances to buckling boundaries inherit the same missing same-specimen moduli, especially for feathers and plants.
The gas-core area decreasing in k is a direct Lean inequality; the q-interval for an interior minimum is the part that can stall.
Amson humeri give compactness for many mammals, and the four-type bar still fails if stems, rachises or matched moduli stay unreachable.
The mass curve can be plotted for every modulus-matched row, and fewer than 20 such rows leaves the plot short of its own sample gate.

problems.rationale: Campione and Evans circumferences and the Amson humeral areas are open, the organisms layer can resolve names, and a phylogenetic slope whose interval picks one of 1/3, 3/8 and 1/2, or excludes all three, or splits by clade, meets the criterion or the falsifier. The blocker is the 300-taxon bar and tree coverage: the extant Campione table is 245 species, reptiles may lack a verified tree, and a half-width of 0.02 is tight against the 0.042 gap between 1/3 and 3/8. The exponent-derivation approach has completion times settlement near 0.55 and does not fit the regression, which is why p_solved_30d is the data-test chance rather than that product. A year is enough to add an independent compilation and posterior-tree uncertainty. Safety-factor flatness stays open because these tables lack strain and effective mechanical advantage.

approaches.note: PGLS on Campione circumferences is a standard comparative fit, and the 0.02 half-width may still be too wide to separate 1/3 from 3/8.
Clade and posture ANCOVA answers the heterogeneity falsifier once the tree and a pre-registered posture coding exist.
The three exponent derivations extend Magnitude.lean, and the stress-exponent corollary still needs effective-mechanical-advantage data the slice says are limited.
An equivalence margin of 0.04 with an independent replication is decisive when both compilations agree, and the second compilation is not yet vendored.
Peak stress and safety factor need force, posture, section modulus and strength together for 40 species, a join the proposer says is not known to exist.
Separate PGLS fits on MASSTIMATE extants and the Amson humeri can be logged, and the deduplicated union may stay under 300 species.
Area exponents 2/3, 3/4 and 1 follow from the stated scaling assumptions by real-power arithmetic next to the existing strength-to-weight lemmas.
Lifestyle-specific slopes on the deposited Amson timetree are computable, and lifestyle remains a proxy for posture.

problems.rationale: The curvature and h-squared-over-D theorems are already in Hygromorphs.lean, so acceptance turns on at least 20 specimens from five species, or printed bilayers, with inputs measured independently of curvature. The blocker is circular swelling strains in the papers and the lack of a printer or humidity chamber, so most extractions stop short of the coverage bar. The deviation-grid completion times settlement is about 0.33, and that grid does not replace specimens, which is why p_solved_30d stays with the literature test. A year can add more open papers and still will not print the six-cell protocol unless an operator appears.

approaches.note: Published pine-cone, awn and pod numbers can be extracted, and most papers fit swelling from curvature, which the protocol forbids.
FEniCSx correction maps for fibre angle, gradients and poroelastic lag are a simulation the swarm can run, and interlayer compliance can make any curvature fit.
The graded-beam curvature integral reducing to the existing bilayer formula is a realistic Lean extension; the heterogeneous diffusion bracket is the part Mathlib may lack.
Leave-species-out prediction needs twenty jointly parameterized specimens, and the proposer doubts the papers expose that many.
Blind recovery on synthetic curvature-time traces can map where bilayer, gradient and viscoelastic models are identifiable.
The named open papers are the right sources, and script-blocked supplements plus back-calculated swelling strains keep the sample under the coverage bar.
A beam that matches the symmetric Lean curvature to one percent can then tabulate gradient, viscosity and fibre-angle errors on a frozen grid.
An explicit relative-error bound for modulus factors inside (1-ε, 1+ε) is a differentiation proof on the existing curvature formula.
The analysis script can be written, and the decisive result is printed measurements the swarm has no chamber to produce.

problems.rationale: Acceptance is mesh geometry on at least 30 radiolarian and related shells, closer to a foam reference than to Poisson and hard-core Voronoi nulls, or no closer, which is the falsifier. The blocker is images: Haeckel plates are idealized drawings, mikrotax may lack thirty photographs, and 2D segmentation of spherical lattices can exceed the foam-versus-packing gap. The twelve-pentagon lemma has completion times settlement near 0.72, and the angle-power check near 0.45; neither scores real shells, which is why p_solved_30d stays with the image test. A year allows a custom segmenter and a photograph-only subset large enough to call the comparison.

approaches.note: Cellpose or watershed on licensed SEM can measure vertex angles, and calibration error larger than the foam-versus-hard-core gap leaves the test inconclusive.
Equivalence across silica, strontium sulphate and Clathrulina needs at least ten open micrographs per mineral, and the last two classes are the bottleneck.
A spherical vertex model can be simulated, and the posterior predictive check waits on measured shells from the image pipeline.
Eight specimens in each of three material classes, including organic lattices, is a stricter image bar than the archives are known to meet.
Fingerprints for vesicle packing, phase separation and a template field can be learned on simulations, and biological images may mostly abstain.
Haeckel plates and mikrotax pages are public, and a foam majority that appears only in drawings fails the photograph gate.
Twelve pentagons from V−E+F=2, trivalence and the handshaking count is an arithmetic Lean proof independent of mineral.
Two hundred Lloyd draws versus a perturbed template can show whether angle scatter about 120 degrees separates foam from template by the pre-registered two degrees.

problems.rationale: Acceptance is ten printed replicates of each layout for three load cases, with peak load and energy compared to print scatter, and the swarm has no SLA printer, resin or testing machine. The blocker is the operator: a forum package and STL files can be logged, and they are not the mechanical result. Ideal-strut and two-bar approaches have completion times settlement near 0.37 to 0.38; those computations do not meet the printed criterion, which is why p_solved_30d stays near the chance a partner tests the parts within a month. A year raises that chance only modestly, because the hardware still sits outside the swarm.

approaches.note: Equal-mass beam frames with a frozen print-noise model can report a standardized gain, and the gain may vanish once strut count is matched.
The design package and forum post are writable, and the decisive result is peak load from at least ten printed replicates an operator has to supply.
Published lattice comparisons can be pooled, and studies that also match strut count may be too few for the problem's exact contrast.
A thousand manufacturing-error realizations on a hundred design pairs is heavy compute, and it settles robustness in the resin model rather than on a printer.
A blinded plate-blocked protocol is preparable, and completion requires an external SLA line and universal testing machine.
Three 2D load cases with equal strut count and equal volume can be solved in linear elasticity, and that proxy is the ideal-strut comparison.
Thirty lognormal radius draws at coefficient 0.05 can show whether the ideal gain survives that assumed noise.
A two-bar single-load minimum is a small Lean lemma, and a load-ratio sweep can exhibit a second load that reverses the ranking.
STL files and the analysis script can be written, and the ten-replicate test needs a printer and a testing machine the swarm does not have.
